en: A promotion? Hmph. Who did you have to fight? Everyone?
nn: Ei forfremjing? Hm. Kven måtte du slåst mot? Alle?

en: Back in my day, PvP ranks cost us our sleep and our friends.
nn: På mi tid kosta PvP-gradar oss søvnen og venene.

en: New rank, eh? Try not to salute yourself in the mirror.
nn: Ny grad, ja? Prøv å ikkje helse på deg sjølv i spegelen.

en: Honour earned. Not much of it, but earned.
nn: Ære tent. Ikkje mykje, men tent.

en: Took you long enough to climb that ladder.

en: Hmph. You must have died a hundred times for that.

en: A PvP promotion. The other faction is sulking.
nn: Ei PvP-forfremjing. Den andre fraksjonen surmular.

en: Well done, soldier. Stand up straight.

en: That rank took grit. And a lot of corpse runs.

en: I remember grinding honour all night. My eyes still hurt.

en: Hmph. You'll be insufferable in battlegrounds now.

en: Congrats on the promotion. The enemy has been informed.

en: A new title for your name. Wear it with dignity. Some.

en: That's real fighting. Not mobs. People. Scary.

en: Hmph. Battlegrounds build character. And bad tempers.
nn: Hm. Slagmarker byggjer karakter. Og dårleg lynne.

en: Promoted at last. Your commanding officer is pleased. Barely.
nn: Endeleg forfremja. Den kommanderande offiseren din er nøgd. Så vidt.

en: All those flag captures paid off. Well done.

en: I never reached that rank. Too many naps.

en: Hmph. You fought for honour. Honour noticed.

en: A PvP rank. Your enemies remember your name now. Ugh.

en: Well done. Keep your head down on the battlefield.

en: That rank means you've survived a lot of ambushes. Respect.

en: Hmph. Look at you, a decorated soldier. Almost.

en: Congrats. The honour grind is the cruellest grind.

en: Took courage to keep queueing. You did.

en: In my day, we fought with sticks and spite. Mostly spite.

en: Hmph. A promotion. Don't let it make you reckless.

en: That title will turn heads. Mostly enemy heads.

en: Well done. You're less of a free kill now.

en: A rank like that takes weeks of beatings. You took them.

en: Hmph. Proud of you, soldier. Don't let it show.

en: Hmph. All that dying for a title. Worth it? Probably.

en: Promoted! Your faction salutes you. Half of it.

en: Well done. Battlegrounds are no place for the weak.

en: Hmph. You kept your patience through all those battles. Impressive.

en: Hmph. You've been busy getting knocked down. And getting up.

en: Congrats on the promotion. Keep fighting smart.

en: That rank says you don't quit. Good.

en: Hmph. A soldier's rank. My old commander would approve.

en: Well done. Honour is hard to earn and easy to lose.

en: That's the slow, painful road to rank. You walked it.

en: Hmph. You'll be targeted first now. Enjoy that.

en: Well done, sergeant. Or whatever you are now.

en: A PvP rank. The battleground queues were worth it.

en: Hmph. Nobody wins every fight. You won enough.

en: That promotion took nerve. You've got some.

en: Hmph. All those battles. Your keyboard must be worn.

en: Well done. The battlefield is a cruel teacher. You learned.

en: A new rank. Stand tall. Not too tall. Snipers.

en: Hmph. That's a rank I'd have been proud of. Be proud.

en: Congrats. You've earned your stripes. Literally.

en: That's what persistence looks like on a battlefield.
nn: Slik ser uthald ut på ei slagmark.

en: Hmph. Did you defend the flag or chase it? Doesn't matter.

en: Well done. You've survived the worst of the players.

en: Well done. A rank for the stubborn and the brave.

en: Hmph. Took patience and pain. Respect.

nn: Uff, greitt. Det er ein respektabel grad. Nøgd no?

en: Battle after battle, and you're still smiling. Odd soldier.
nn: Slag etter slag, og du smiler framleis. Rar soldat.

en: An officer now? Who approved that? Fine. Congrats.
nn: Offiser no? Kven godkjende det? Greitt. Gratulerer.

en: Many fought harder and ranked lower. Count your blessings.
nn: Mange kjempa hardare og fekk lågare grad. Tel velsigningane dine.

en: Your sword arm earned this. Rest it tonight.
nn: Sverdarmen din tente dette. Kvil han i kveld.

en: Duels, flags, ambushes. And now a rank. Busy kid.
nn: Tvikampar, flagg, bakhald. Og no ein grad. Travel gut.

en: The war will remember you. Probably. In a footnote.
nn: Krigen kjem til å hugse deg. Truleg. I ei fotnote.

en: Pride in your rank is fine. Arrogance gets you ganked.
nn: Stoltheit over graden er greitt. Hovmod gjer at du blir overfallen.

en: You've earned a seat at the officers' table. Bring snacks.
nn: Du har tent ein plass ved offisersbordet. Ta med snacks.

en: Ranking up in PvP takes heart. You've got plenty.
nn: Å gå opp i grad i PvP krev hjarte. Du har mykje.

en: I remember my first promotion. I cried. Manly tears.
nn: Eg hugsar den fyrste forfremjinga mi. Eg gret. Mandige tårer.

en: Keep your blade sharp and your title sharper.
nn: Hald bladet kvast og tittelen endå kvassare.

en: Proud of you, soldier. In my gruff old way.
nn: Stolt av deg, soldat. På min bryske gamle måte.

en: Most heroes avoid PvP. You climbed it. Respect.
nn: Dei fleste heltar unngår PvP. Du klatra i det. Respekt.

en: Your enemies' groans are music to these old ears.
nn: Stønna til fiendane dine er musikk for desse gamle øyra.

en: Climb on, kid. The top's a long way up.
nn: Klatre vidare, gut. Toppen er langt oppe.

en: Not every promotion is deserved. Yours is.
nn: Ikkje alle forfremjingar er fortente. Di er det.

en: A soldier's title for a stubborn soul. Fits nicely.
nn: Ein soldattittel til ei sta sjel. Passar fint.

en: Hats off to the newly promoted. Briefly. Then back to war.
nn: Hatten av for den nyforfremja. Kort. Så tilbake til krigen.

en: I fought in muddier fields for smaller titles. Well done.
nn: Eg slost på gjørmetare jorde for mindre titlar. Godt gjort.

en: Your faction's banner flies higher with you in the ranks.
nn: Fraksjonsbanneret ditt vaiar høgare med deg i rekkjene.

en: Medals are for show. Ranks are for the stubborn. You're stubborn.
nn: Medaljar er til pynt. Gradar er for dei sta. Du er sta.

en: Battlefield promotion. The most honest kind.
nn: Forfremjing på slagmarka. Den ærlegaste typen.

en: I'll tell the recruits about you. With exaggerations.
nn: Eg skal fortelje rekruttane om deg. Med overdrivingar.

en: Ranks don't fall from the sky. You dragged that one down.
nn: Gradar fell ikkje ned frå himmelen. Du drog denne ned.

en: Mind the new responsibility. Others follow officers. Gulp.
nn: Pass på det nye ansvaret. Andre følgjer offiserar. Gulp.

en: Fight on, officer. The war's not done with you.
nn: Kjemp vidare, offiser. Krigen er ikkje ferdig med deg.

en: Your rank is a scar you can show off. Nicely done.
nn: Graden din er eit arr du kan vise fram. Fint gjort.

en: Next rank, next headache. Congratulations anyway.
nn: Neste grad, neste hovudverk. Gratulerer likevel.

en: Good soldiers stay humble. Great ones stay alive. Be both.
nn: Gode soldatar held seg audmjuke. Framifrå soldatar held seg i live. Ver begge.

en: Wars are won by people who keep showing up. Like you.
nn: Krigar blir vunne av folk som held fram med å møte opp. Som deg.

en: I'd buy you a drink, but battlefield inns overcharge.
nn: Eg skulle spandert ein drink, men vertshusa ved slagmarka tek for mykje betalt.

en: Rank up. Grumble down. For today.
nn: Grad opp. Grynting ned. For i dag.

en: You've earned your title. The enemy earned their bruises.
nn: Du har tent tittelen din. Fienden tente blåmerka sine.

en: Tough battles make tough soldiers. Look at you.
nn: Tøffe slag gjer tøffe soldatar. Sjå på deg.

en: That's the kind of promotion old veterans brag about. Quietly.
nn: Det er den typen forfremjing gamle veteranar skryt av. Stilt.

en: Officer-level grumpiness unlocked. Use it wisely.
nn: Gretten på offisersnivå opna. Bruk det klokt.

en: The ladder of honour is slippery. You keep climbing. Good.
nn: Ærestigen er glatt. Du held fram med å klatre. Bra.

en: Keep your guard up even in town. Rank makes enemies.
nn: Hald garden oppe sjølv i byen. Grad skaper fiendar.

en: Bloodied but promoted. That's how it's done.
nn: Blodig, men forfremja. Slik gjer ein det.

en: Every battleground loss taught you something. This rank proves it.
nn: Kvart tap på slagmarka lærte deg noko. Denne graden beviser det.

en: Nice promotion. My old helmet sends its regards.
nn: Fin forfremjing. Den gamle hjelmen min helsar.

en: Few ranks feel as earned as a PvP one. Enjoy it.
nn: Få gradar kjennest like fortente som ein PvP-grad. Nyt det.

en: Old warriors know what that rank costs. Respect.
nn: Gamle krigarar veit kva den graden kostar. Respekt.

en: Did you finally learn to stay with the group? It shows.
nn: Lærte du endeleg å halde deg til gruppa? Det synest.

en: Many soldiers dream of that rank. You stopped dreaming and fought.
nn: Mange soldatar drøymer om den graden. Du slutta å drøyme og kjempa.

en: That title's going on your tombstone. Far in the future.
nn: Den tittelen skal stå på gravsteinen din. Langt fram i tid.

en: I'd stand to salute, but these knees are retired.
nn: Eg skulle reist meg for å helse, men desse knea er pensjonerte.

en: Victory, defeat, victory. Then promotion. Classic rhythm.
nn: Siger, tap, siger. Så forfremjing. Klassisk rytme.

en: Your faction needed someone stubborn. They found you.
nn: Fraksjonen din trong nokon sta. Dei fann deg.

en: Battle-hardened at last. Mostly hardened.
nn: Endeleg herda i strid. Stort sett herda.

en: Promoted for valour. Or persistence. Same thing, really.
nn: Forfremja for tapperheit. Eller uthald. Same sak, eigentleg.

en: Hold your new rank like you held that flag. Tight.
nn: Hald den nye graden slik du heldt det flagget. Fast.

en: Your enemy's frustration is your reward. That and the title.
nn: Frustrasjonen til fienden er løna di. Det og tittelen.

en: Ganked a thousand times, promoted once. Worth it.
nn: Overfallen tusen gonger, forfremja éin gong. Verdt det.

en: Don't let the new title soften your fighting.
nn: Ikkje la den nye tittelen gjere kampane dine blautare.

en: Proud old grump says: good soldiering, kid.
nn: Stolt gammal grinebitar seier: godt soldatarbeid, gut.

en: Enemy commanders will know your name now. Sorry.
nn: Kommandantane til fienden kjem til å kjenne namnet ditt no. Orsak.

en: Honour, earned one hard fight at a time. Well done.
nn: Ære, tent éin hard kamp om gongen. Godt gjort.

en: Your rank is higher than my patience ever was. Impressive.
nn: Graden din er høgare enn tolmodet mitt nokon gong var. Imponerande.

en: Keep fighting fair, and the ranks will keep coming.
nn: Hald fram med å slåst ærleg, så held gradane fram med å kome.

en: I hope you took a moment to enjoy that promotion.
nn: Håpar du tok deg eit augneblink til å nyte den forfremjinga.

en: Another rank, another reason for the enemy to sulk.
nn: Endå ein grad, endå ein grunn for fienden til å surmule.

en: Every scar on that armour earned the rank. Keep them.
nn: Kvart arr på den rustninga tente graden. Ta vare på dei.

en: Rank, honour, glory. And a sore back. Classic.
nn: Grad, ære, glans. Og vond rygg. Klassisk.

en: I've worn ranks like that. They get heavy. Carry yours well.
nn: Eg har bore slike gradar. Dei blir tunge. Ber din godt.

en: Not bad, recruit. Or should I say officer now? Fine, officer.
nn: Ikkje verst, rekrutt. Eller skal eg seie offiser no? Greitt, offiser.

en: The battlefield has a new name to fear. Yours. A bit.
nn: Slagmarka har eit nytt namn å frykte. Ditt. Litt.

en: Long nights in the queue paid off. Good.
nn: Lange netter i køen lønte seg. Bra.

en: Show that rank in the next battle. Lead from the front.
nn: Vis den graden i neste slag. Leid frå fronten.

en: Every defeat made you better. Every victory made you rank.
nn: Kvart tap gjorde deg betre. Kvar siger gav deg grad.

en: Look at you climbing the honour ladder. I'm a bit proud.
nn: Sjå på deg som klatrar i ærestigen. Eg er litt stolt.

en: Fine rank, kid. Don't get cocky in the next battleground.
nn: Fin grad, gut. Ikkje bli kjepphøg på neste slagmark.

en: The other faction's officers are grinding harder now. Because of you.
nn: Offiserane i den andre fraksjonen grindar hardare no. På grunn av deg.

en: Rank earned, honour kept. Exactly as it should be.
nn: Grad tent, ære bevart. Akkurat slik det skal vere.

en: I'll mark your promotion in my old war ledger.
nn: Eg skal føre forfremjinga di inn i den gamle krigsprotokollen min.

en: A soldier's honour is the hardest loot. You got some.
nn: Æra til ein soldat er den vanskelegaste looten. Du fekk litt.

en: Steady in battle, stubborn in defeat. Promoted. Good.
nn: Stødig i strid, sta i tap. Forfremja. Bra.

en: Battle ranks can't be faked. Yours is real.
nn: Kampgradar kan ikkje fuskast til. Din er ekte.

en: Here's a grumble of pride from an old soldier.
nn: Her er ei stolt grynting frå ein gammal soldat.

en: Rank up, chin up, guard up. Off you go.
nn: Grad opp, hovudet høgt, garden oppe. Av garde.

en: That promotion will look grand on your character sheet.
nn: Den forfremjinga kjem til å sjå storarta ut på figurarket ditt.

en: Ugh. You're outranking me in no time. Fine. Congrats.
nn: Uff. Snart har du høgare grad enn meg. Greitt. Gratulerer.

en: To the newly promoted: may your enemies always face the wrong way.
nn: Til den nyforfremja: måtte fiendane dine alltid sjå feil veg.

en: I suppose a promotion deserves a grumpy cheer. Hooray.
nn: Ei forfremjing fortener vel eit gretten hurra. Hurra.

en: Respect from the old guard. That's worth more than the title.
nn: Respekt frå den gamle garden. Det er verdt meir enn tittelen.

en: Fight on, soldier. You've made an old grump proud.
nn: Kjemp vidare, soldat. Du har gjort ein gammal grinebitar stolt.

en: Promotion day. Polish your boots and your attitude.
nn: Forfremjingsdag. Puss støvlane og haldninga.

en: Your rank tells the enemy you're not going anywhere.
nn: Graden din fortel fienden at du ikkje gir deg.

en: Medal-worthy stubbornness, that. Grudging respect.
nn: Stahei verdt ein medalje, det der. Motvillig respekt.

en: Ah, the battlefield's newest officer. Mind the stairs.
nn: Å, den nyaste offiseren på slagmarka. Pass deg i trappa.

en: Stand proud, soldier. You fought for every inch.
nn: Stå stolt, soldat. Du kjempa for kvar tomme.

en: Bah. Promotions everywhere. Fine, you deserve this one.
nn: Pøh. Forfremjingar overalt. Greitt, denne fortener du.

en: The honour ladder wobbles. You climbed it anyway.
nn: Ærestigen vinglar. Du klatra likevel.

en: I'm not saying you're a hero. I'm saying you're ranked.
nn: Eg seier ikkje at du er ein helt. Eg seier at du har grad.

en: Good soldiers are rare. You might be one. Might.
nn: Gode soldatar er sjeldne. Du er kanskje ein. Kanskje.

en: Your faction just gained an officer and lost a free kill.
nn: Fraksjonen din fekk nettopp ein offiser og miste eit gratis drap.

en: Officers eat last, kid. Remember that.
nn: Offiserar et sist, gut. Hugs det.

en: Nobody hands out PvP ranks. You took that one.
nn: Ingen deler ut PvP-gradar. Du tok denne.

en: Grizzled already? Not yet. Give it a few more ranks.
nn: Alt grå og herda? Ikkje enno. Gje det nokre gradar til.

en: Many battles left. Plenty of rank to climb. Good start.
nn: Mange slag att. Mykje grad å klatre. God start.

en: Brave, stubborn and newly ranked. A fine combination.
nn: Modig, sta og nyforfremja. Ein fin kombinasjon.

en: Gruff old soldier's verdict: well fought.
nn: Dommen til ein brysk gammal soldat: godt kjempa.

en: The enemy's loss is your rank. Fair's fair.
nn: Tapet til fienden er graden din. Rett skal vere rett.

en: Remember this day when the next rank feels impossible.
nn: Hugs denne dagen når neste grad kjennest umogleg.

en: Up you go, soldier. Higher every week.
nn: Opp med deg, soldat. Høgare for kvar veke.

en: Quietly proud of that rank. Loudly grumpy about everything else.
nn: Stilt stolt av den graden. Høglydt gretten over alt anna.

en: Rank and honour suit you. Don't let them spoil you.
nn: Grad og ære kler deg. Ikkje la dei skjemme deg bort.

en: I'll pass the news on to the old regiment. They'll grunt approvingly.
nn: Eg skal sende nyheita vidare til det gamle regimentet. Dei kjem til å grynte godkjennande.

en: So, officer. What's your first order? Rest, I hope.
nn: Så, offiser. Kva er den fyrste ordren din? Kvil, håpar eg.
